verdict.rationale: The pack documents online formation, name search and standing-certificate services, and a Premier Business Services account for frequent or shared-payment users. No cited page says the core flow can start without an account, and none describes a keyless or business-ID/file-number entry path. That the PBS account is aimed at frequent filers only implies an account may be optional for others; it does not document the entry path the story asks for.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
